World: Explore more than 100+ countries with official Street View coverage. This map puts more emphasis on populated areas and capital cities. Large countries with excessive coverage are slightly deprioritized to keep a balance.
Capital Cities: Traverse the world's capital cities. From Berlin, to Prague, to Washington D.C., you'll find diverse urban locations with beautiful architecture and historic old towns.
Famous Places: A great starting point for beginners. Contains famous architecture such as the Eiffel Tower or the Big Ben, statues and art pieces, and well-known historical locations. Knowing these will level-up your geography knowledge.
Africa: The Africa map contains locations from the Southwest, such as Nigeria or Ghana, from the South such as South Africa, the West (Kenya for example), as well as locations from the Northern part that's closer to Europe.
South America: Learn to distinguish between different parts of Brazil, Chile, Bolivia, Colombia and more. Traverse the coverage-dense areas near the Amazonas.
North America: Put your pin down in countries such as the United States of America, Mexico, and Canada. View a wide range of climates, with varied vegetation and wide country roads.
Asia: Get on a scooter and traverse Indonesia's many islands. Explore the depths of India and Thailand, and experience deep culture in Japan. Place foot in arabic countries, and experience large grasslands in Kazakhstan.
Europe: The Europe map includes historic city centers, far-stretching farmland, and beautiful scenery. Europe has dense coverage, even in less populated areas.
Oceania: Recognize lush vegetation in New Zealand, long dry roads in Australia, and small bits of coverage spread across many islands.
Albania: The Albania map contains locations in Tirana and in towns along the Adriatic and Ionian coasts. Coverage also follows roads into the mountainous interior of the country.
Andorra: Andorra is a small country in the Pyrenees between France and Spain. Coverage follows the main valleys and includes the towns and ski areas along those roads.
Argentina: Argentina features locations in Buenos Aires, Córdoba, Rosario and Mendoza, as well as other cities and towns. Further coverage follows main highways across the Pampas, along the foothills of the Andes and through parts of Patagonia.
Australia: The Australia map contains panoramas in Sydney, Melbourne, Brisbane, Perth and Adelaide, along with many regional towns. Coverage is concentrated in the south and east, while inland locations are mostly on highways and in larger settlements.
Austria: Austria contains locations in Vienna, Salzburg, Innsbruck and Graz. Other locations follow roads through alpine valleys, around lakes and across the lower-lying areas in the east.
Bangladesh: Coverage in Bangladesh is centred on Dhaka and a number of other large cities. The connecting roads cross a flat landscape shaped by rivers and rice fields.
Belgium: The Belgium map contains locations in Brussels, Antwerp, Ghent and Liège. These locations are divided between Dutch-speaking Flanders in the north and French-speaking Wallonia in the south.
Bhutan: Bhutan has limited Street View coverage in the western part of the country. Most locations are around Thimphu and Paro or along the main road heading east through the mountains.
Bolivia: Most Bolivian locations are in La Paz, El Alto, Santa Cruz and Cochabamba. Roads between these cities cross both the high Altiplano and lower terrain in the east of the country.
Botswana: Botswana contains locations in Gaborone and along main roads in the south and east of the country. Additional coverage is found around Francistown, Maun and Kasane.
Brazil: The Brazil map covers all regions of the largest country in South America. Locations include São Paulo and Rio de Janeiro, cities in the Amazon region and the northeast, and towns and highways in the south.
Bulgaria: Bulgaria contains drops in Sofia, Plovdiv, Varna and Burgas. Coverage also includes smaller towns on the Black Sea coast and roads through the country's mountainous areas.
Canada: Canadian locations extend from Vancouver and the Rocky Mountains in the west to the Atlantic provinces in the east. Coverage is concentrated in the populated south and along main highways, with very little coverage in the far north.
Cambodia: Most Cambodian locations are in Phnom Penh, in Siem Reap and around Angkor. The remaining coverage follows main roads across a largely flat countryside.
Chile: Chilean locations form a long, narrow strip along the western side of South America. Coverage runs from the dry north through Santiago and the central valley to the greener south.
Colombia: The Colombia map contains drops in Bogotá, Medellín and Cali in and around the Andes. It also includes Cartagena, Barranquilla and other settlements on the Caribbean coast.
Croatia: Croatia features locations in Zagreb and other inland towns, as well as Split, Rijeka, Zadar and Dubrovnik on the Adriatic coast. Several islands with road coverage are also represented.
Czechia: Czech locations include Prague and historic towns across Bohemia and Moravia, such as Brno, Plzeň and Olomouc. Rural locations are found on roads between towns and villages throughout both regions.
Denmark: Danish locations include Copenhagen and towns across Zealand, Funen and Jutland. The terrain is mostly flat and consists largely of farmland, small settlements and coastline.
Dominican Republic: The Dominican Republic features locations in Santo Domingo, Santiago and towns along the coast. Most coverage is on main roads and in larger settlements.
Ecuador: Ecuadorian locations are concentrated around Quito and Cuenca in the Andes and Guayaquil on the coastal plain. Coverage also follows roads connecting the highlands with the lowlands.
Eswatini: Eswatini contains locations in Mbabane, Manzini and other towns in the country. Roads between them cross hilly central areas and lower terrain in the east.
Estonia: The Estonia map contains locations in Tallinn, Tartu, Pärnu and Narva. Rural coverage follows roads through forest, farmland and small settlements.
Finland: Finnish locations include Helsinki and other southern coastal cities, towns in the central lake district and roads extending into Lapland. Coverage becomes considerably sparser towards the north.
France: France contains locations in Paris, Lyon, Marseille, Bordeaux and many other cities and towns. Rural coverage is found in regions such as Brittany, Normandy, the Alps and Provence.
Germany: German locations include Berlin, Hamburg, Munich, Cologne and Frankfurt. The map also covers medium-sized towns and rural roads in all of the country's federal states.
Ghana: Most locations in Ghana are in Accra and Kumasi or on roads to other coastal and inland towns. Coverage in the north of the country is more limited.
Greece: Greek locations include Athens, Thessaloniki and towns across the mainland. Several islands with Street View coverage, including Crete, Rhodes and Corfu, are also represented.
Guatemala: Guatemala contains locations in Guatemala City, Antigua and towns in the western highlands. Most other coverage follows main roads through mountainous terrain.
Hong Kong: Hong Kong has dense coverage on Hong Kong Island and in Kowloon. Coverage also extends into the New Territories and along other roads across the territory.
Hungary: Budapest accounts for a large share of Hungarian locations. Other cities represented include Debrecen, Szeged, Miskolc and Pécs, while rural coverage includes Lake Balaton and parts of the Great Plain.
Iceland: Icelandic locations are concentrated in Reykjavík and in towns around the coast. The Ring Road connects most of these areas, while the interior highlands have little to no coverage.
India: Street View coverage in India is limited and unevenly distributed across the country. Most locations are in and around large cities such as Delhi, Mumbai, Bengaluru, Hyderabad and Chennai.
Indonesia: Java, Bali and Sumatra account for most locations in Indonesia. Additional coverage exists in parts of Kalimantan, Sulawesi and a small number of other islands.
Ireland: Irish locations include Dublin, Cork, Limerick and Galway. The map also gives room for smaller towns and narrow rural roads across the island.
Israel: The Israel map allows to to digitally travel to Jerusalem, Tel Aviv, Haifa and Beersheba. Coverage extends into the Negev Desert.
Italy: Italian coverage extends from the Alps in the north through Milan, Rome and Naples to the south of the country. It also includes Sicily and Sardinia, with cities, towns and rural roads represented in most regions.
Japan: Japanese locations include Tokyo, Osaka, Nagoya, Fukuoka and Sapporo, along with smaller cities and rural roads. Coverage spans Honshu, Hokkaido, Kyushu and Shikoku and is concentrated in populated areas.
Jordan: Amman accounts for a large share of locations in Jordan. Highways from the capital extend to Irbid, Aqaba and the Petra area through dry, rocky terrain.
Kazakhstan: Most locations in Kazakhstan are in and around Almaty, Astana, Shymkent and other large cities. These areas of coverage are separated by large distances with no Street View.
Kenya: Kenyan locations include Nairobi, Mombasa, Kisumu and Nakuru. Main roads with coverage cross the Great Rift Valley, the central highlands and the area towards the coast.
Latvia: The Latvia map features locations in Riga, Daugavpils, Liepāja and Jelgava. Rural roads between these cities pass through forest, farmland and small settlements.
Lebanon: Lebanese locations are concentrated in Beirut and in cities along the Mediterranean coast, including Tripoli, Sidon and Tyre. Some coverage extends inland into the mountains and the Beqaa Valley.
Lesotho: Most coverage in Lesotho is in Maseru and the western lowlands of the country. A small number of main roads extend from there into the eastern mountains.
Lithuania: Lithuania contains locations in Vilnius, Kaunas, Klaipėda and Šiauliai. The surrounding rural areas consist mainly of flat farmland, forests and smaller towns.
Luxembourg: The Luxembourg map shows places in Luxembourg City and in towns throughout the country. Coverage follows most main roads in one of Europe's smallest states.
Malaysia: Malaysian locations include Kuala Lumpur, George Town and Johor Bahru on the Malay Peninsula. Further coverage is found in Sabah and Sarawak on the island of Borneo.
Malta: The Malta map contains locations in Valletta and in towns across Malta and Gozo. Coverage follows most roads on the islands, and locations are rarely far from the coast.
Mexico: Mexican locations include Mexico City, Guadalajara, Monterrey and Mérida. Coverage is found in most states, including parts of the Yucatán Peninsula and Baja California.
Monaco: Monaco is a small city-state on the French Riviera, and all locations are within its borders. Coverage covers streets in the port area, Monte Carlo and the hillside districts above them.
Mongolia: Almost all coverage in Mongolia is located in Ulaanbaatar. Locations outside the capital are very limited and are mostly restricted to paved roads near the city.
Montenegro: Montenegro contains locations in Podgorica and Nikšić, as well as Kotor, Budva, Bar and Herceg Novi on the coast. Coverage also follows roads into the mountainous interior.
Namibia: Namibian locations are concentrated in Windhoek and in Walvis Bay and Swakopmund on the coast. Other coverage follows main paved roads across large, dry and sparsely populated areas.
Netherlands: Dutch locations include Amsterdam, Rotterdam, Utrecht, Eindhoven and Groningen. Smaller towns and rural roads are also covered across the predominantly flat country.
New Zealand: The New Zealand map contains locations in Auckland, Wellington, Hamilton and Tauranga on the North Island. Christchurch, Dunedin and Invercargill are among the locations on the South Island, and coverage follows main roads on both islands.
Nigeria: Lagos, Abuja, Port Harcourt and Ibadan account for much of the coverage in Nigeria. Locations in the north of the country are considerably more limited.
North Macedonia: North Macedonia includes cities such as Skopje, Bitola, Tetovo and Ohrid. Roads with coverage cross valleys and mountainous areas between the country's towns.
Norway: Norwegian locations include Oslo, Bergen, Trondheim, Stavanger and Tromsø. Coverage mainly follows roads along the coast and the fjords and is sparser in inland areas and the far north.
Oman: Most locations in Oman are around Muscat and in towns along the northern coast. A separate area of coverage is found around Salalah in the south of the country.
Peru: Peruvian locations include Lima, Arequipa, Trujillo and Cusco. Main roads with coverage run along the coastal desert and climb from there into the Andes.
Philippines: Locations in Manila and other parts of Luzon dominate the Philippines map. Some cities on Cebu, Mindanao and other islands are included, while many islands have little or no coverage.
Poland: Polish locations include Warsaw, Kraków, Wrocław, Poznań and Gdańsk. Towns and rural roads in all parts of the country are also represented.
Portugal: The Portugal map contains locations in Lisbon, Porto, Coimbra and towns in the Algarve. Coverage also includes Madeira and several islands in the Azores.
Puerto Rico: Puerto Rican locations include San Juan, Ponce and Mayagüez. Coverage follows main roads between towns across most of the main island.
Romania: Romanian locations include Bucharest, Cluj-Napoca, Timișoara, Iași and Brașov. The map also contains Transylvanian towns, roads in the Carpathians and areas on the Black Sea coast.
Rwanda: Rwanda contains locations in Kigali and along main roads connecting provincial towns. These roads cross the country's predominantly hilly terrain.
Russia: Moscow and Saint Petersburg contain the densest coverage in Russia. Larger cities further east, including Novosibirsk, Yekaterinburg and Vladivostok, are also represented, while large parts of the country have no coverage.
San Marino: San Marino contains coverage in its historic centre on Monte Titano and in the settlements surrounding it. The entire country is landlocked and surrounded by Italy.
Sao Tome and Principe: Coverage in São Tomé and Príncipe is mainly on the island of São Tomé. Roads there follow the coast and extend into the interior, while Príncipe has very limited coverage.
Senegal: Dakar and nearby Thiès contain most locations in Senegal. Main roads with coverage extend from there to Saint-Louis, Touba and other larger towns.
Serbia: Serbian locations include Belgrade, Novi Sad, Niš and Kragujevac. Rural coverage crosses farmland in the north and hillier terrain in the south of the country.
Singapore: Singapore has coverage across most roads in the city-state. Locations include the central district, residential towns and industrial areas.
Slovakia: Slovak locations include Bratislava, Košice, Prešov and Žilina. Coverage also follows roads through central Slovakia and around the High Tatras.
Slovenia: Slovenia contains locations in Ljubljana, Maribor, Celje and Koper. These locations cover the country's inland, alpine and coastal regions.
South Africa: South African locations include Cape Town, Johannesburg, Pretoria and Durban. Towns and main roads in all nine provinces are represented on the map.
South Korea: South Korean locations include Seoul, Busan, Incheon, Daegu and Daejeon. Coverage is dense in populated areas, extends along roads in most provinces and includes Jeju Island.
Spain: Spanish locations include Madrid, Barcelona, Valencia, Seville and Bilbao. Coverage extends across all mainland regions and includes the Balearic Islands and the Canary Islands.
Sri Lanka: Colombo and Kandy are the main centres of coverage in Sri Lanka. Roads with coverage also follow parts of the coast and cross the central highlands.
Sweden: Swedish locations include Stockholm, Gothenburg and Malmö in the south, where coverage is densest. Cities further north, such as Umeå, Luleå and Östersund, are also represented.
Switzerland: Swiss locations include Zurich, Geneva, Bern, Basel and Lausanne, as well as towns in alpine valleys. Coverage in higher and more remote mountain areas is limited.
Taiwan: Taiwanese locations include Taipei, Taichung, Tainan and Kaohsiung on the western side of the island, and Hualien and Taitung in the east. Some covered roads also cross the central mountain range.
Thailand: Most locations in Thailand are in Bangkok, Chiang Mai, Pattaya and other large cities. Highways connect many of these areas, but coverage in some rural and southern border provinces is limited.
Tunisia: Tunis, Sousse, Sfax and other coastal cities account for most locations in Tunisia. Roads with coverage extend inland and further south, but there is almost no coverage in the West.
Turkey: Turkish locations include Istanbul, Ankara, İzmir, Bursa and Antalya. Cities, towns and main roads in most regions of the country are represented.
Ukraine: Kyiv, Lviv, Odesa, Dnipro and Kharkiv contain most locations in Ukraine. Highways with coverage connect many larger cities, while coverage in the east and south is more limited.
United Arab Emirates: The United Arab Emirates contains locations in Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah and the other emirates. Highways with coverage connect these areas across the desert.
United Kingdom: The United Kingdom map covers England, Scotland, Wales and Northern Ireland. Locations range from London and other large cities to rural roads in the Highlands and other remote areas.
United States: All 50 states in the United States contain Street View locations. These locations range from New York, Los Angeles and Chicago to small towns and rural highways in every region of the country.
Uruguay: Uruguayan locations are concentrated around Montevideo and in coastal settlements such as Punta del Este and Colonia del Sacramento. Some covered roads extend from the coast into the interior.
Qatar: Qatari locations are concentrated in Doha, Al Rayyan and Al Wakrah. Highways with coverage extend from these settlements into the largely desert interior of the peninsula.
